comment: Single source of truth for the bundled domain packs. Mirrored byte-for-byte into the skill's flat assets/ (drift-tested). Filenames are basenames: the package nests them under assets/<pack>/, the skill copy is flat. The skills[] array below groups packs into one shippable Agent Skill each (one skill per domain); scripts/build-pack-skills.js reads it to emit a single-domain skill per entry. src/packs.js and the skill's verify-setup.js read only .packs and ignore .skills.

skills.title: Municipal Grants & Budgets
skills.description: Use when the user asks to audit or reconcile municipal or public-sector grant and budget spending and wants figures they can trust and reproduce: how much of a grant has been spent, spending broken down by vendor, grant drawdowns against expenditures, budget lines that overran their amended budget, or cash drawn ahead of spending. Answers only through the Civic-Chain Auditor MCP server: every figure is a read-only SQL result checked against the source rows, returned with a result hash and a tamper-evident audit log. Ships a synthetic demo ledger.
